newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Medical CFO Joseph Kuhn resigns.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Medical CFO Joseph Kuhn resigns.

text.p: Advanced Medical Inc said Wednesday that Joseph Kuhn, who was the chief financial officer of Advanced Medical after its merger with IMED Corp, has resigned.
The company said President and Chief Executive William Mercer will serve as acting chief financial officer until a successor is found.

Advanced Medical and IVAC Medical Systems Inc completed a $400 million merger of IVAC and Advanced Medical unit, IMED Corp, in November, creating a worldwide seller of intravenous infusion therapy products.
The company gave no reason for Kuhn's resignation other than to say Kuhn's job in merging the companies was completed.
Advanced Medical said Kuhn will remain with it for a short time to advise on certain merger-related matters.
